## Definition of Ready gate (product owner, ABC-155)

Evidence per box the gate ticks; boxes 5 (estimate) and 7 (priority) were already ticked and are untouched.

- **Box 1** (ACs observable, checked against the implementation, refinement note): the Rebase order / refined 2026-10-31 bullet names the files read - skills/story-to-done/SKILL.md (Arguments, step 4 `in_progress` branch), references/linear.md, references/todo-tracking.md, tests/test_story_to_done.py, README.md, overlays/story-to-done.md; no AC was unimplementable - all three voters' blocking amendments were folded into AC1-AC5 and the story was then accepted (accept round result comment c-005).
- **Box 2** (copy-pattern differences enumerated): AC4 originally invoked the ABC-138 C5 pattern by reference; the refined AC4/AC5 now name the tests, the two commands (`uv run --locked pytest -q`, `uv run --locked python scripts/vendor_shared.py --check`), and the deletion record (PR description), so the ways this case differs are enumerated in the ACs themselves (refinement record c-006).
- **Box 3** (artifact split stated): the split versus ABC-80 (review-loop delta-round cap) is stated in the Additional Context Overlap bullet; the shared-artifact rebase order against ABC-138, ABC-157, ABC-83, ABC-159 is stated in the Additional Context Rebase order bullet.
- **Box 4** (no blockers, backlog search recorded): all four relations are `related`, no blockers; the backlog search recorded on the story (refinement record c-006) found no other story owning a QA-round cap - ABC-80 caps the review delta loop per head, ABC-87 the adversarial gate.
- **Box 6** (team skills and access): engineer one verified the repo, uv.lock, scripts/vendor_shared.py, the 50-test suite at /opt/agent-skills, and the installed profile/overlay are present and accessible (refinement record c-006).
- **Box 8** (business value understood): all three voters found the business value understood - the cohort hypothesis (3 of 15 stories hold 49% of QA rounds, 82% of fix rounds) and the binding (the cap only stops) (refinement record c-006).

Writes next: tick boxes 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 individually, then move the state to Ready To Work.

Owner-directed estimate: the owner set 5 points on ABC-155 after the story-refinement ceremony recorded an unpointed result (see the pointing record, comment 3ceb8bc8). This comment records the directive; the pointing record is not edited.

The product owner's re-refine amendments (pin the continuation state model, scope the pin surface, state the invocation-relative round-counting rule as an AC-level constraint) did not command a shared path.
